items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: And I played on shows, Tom Moss, went from Washbone and Weaver to Tom Moss.

ctx.x: Oh wait, is that Roy Palmer?

Roy Palmer, I'm not to say, Roy Palmer, not Eddie Palmer, Roy Palmer. So then I came back to New Orleans and I stayed about two months and I joined a show named Washbone and Weaver. And I went out with that show. And I played on shows, Tom Moss, went from Washbone and Weaver to Tom Moss. And I came back to New Orleans and I went out and played with a band they called the Black Eagle. That was E.T. Thomas, trumpet player from Crowley, Louisiana. Well, I played with him about two years. And I married, got married…
Now do you remember who else was in that band? Was Lawrence Dewey?
